AI.what: X2Streaming-TTS introduces causal token-level text-to-speech for low-latency streaming dialogue systems.

AI.title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models
AI.what: OpenAI reaffirmed Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previewed Private Safety Processing.
AI.why: Protects user data privacy while enabling advanced AI moderation on frontier models.

AI.title: SkillGate: Training In-Policy Skill Selection in Long-Horizon Agents
AI.what: SkillGate introduces in-policy skill selection for long-horizon agents to choose prompt files dynamically.
AI.why: Optimizes how LLM agents load and apply procedural knowledge mid-episode.

Design.title: AI is lying to us, and nobody seems to care
Design.what: UX Collective published an analysis on how AI interfaces hallucinate and fail to show uncertainty.
Design.why: It highlights critical UX design flaws in conversational and voice agents that erode user trust.
